//: Mutation matrix for THEMED LEAF ROUTING (the follow-up to a92c6dd). Two kinds of subject in one file, because the two halves of this change are one claim: probe_leafroute pins the DECISIONS, and the `themed local-leaf routing parity` gate pins that both surfaces still ask for them. A probe mutant rebuilds and runs the probe; a GATE mutant declares no build (nothing to compile — it is a source gate) and runs native/tools/leafroute-gate-check.sh, which extracts the gate's own lines out of run-headless-probes.sh so this proves the gate CI runs and not a copy of it.

mutants.//: The kind #74 was about. Drop it and every music track answers 'Nothing to play' on both surfaces.
mutants.name: table-musictrack-dropped

mutants.//: #102. Live bug until this change; §3 chains every photo row through the themed path.
mutants.name: table-photo-dropped

mutants.//: #146. Its route is NOT 'open the url' — the acquisition href needs the catalog's auth first.
mutants.name: table-opdsbook-dropped

mutants.//: a92c6dd fault 3: a guidance row reaching the chooser, which offers Play over a line of prose.
mutants.name: themed-enter-info-becomes-chooser
mutants.find: if (type == QLatin1String("info")) return ThemedEnter::Drill;      // guidance prose: inert, never a chooser

mutants.//: A synthetic row ('Play album', Playlists, New…) treated as a leaf: it would open a chooser whose Play routes nowhere.
mutants.name: themed-enter-synthetic-becomes-chooser
mutants.find: if (type.startsWith(QLatin1Char('_'))) return ThemedEnter::Drill;  // synthetic: Playlists, a playlist, New…

mutants.//: A container treated as a leaf — the drill that makes the XMB navigable at all.
mutants.name: themed-enter-container-becomes-chooser
mutants.find: if (expandable) return ThemedEnter::Drill;                        // a container: series / console / volume

mutants.//: The colon trap: a section()-based key reader truncates an album titled 'Vol. 1: Live', and the truncated key resolves to no album.
mutants.name: key-read-with-section

mutants.//: The unusable-row guard: claiming a file route with no url consumes the row and opens nothing, which reads as Enter doing absolutely nothing.
mutants.name: empty-url-claimed-anyway

mutants.//: The tripwire for §4. A router that claims EVERY row satisfies §2 and §3 completely; only the negative section can tell it apart from a correct one.
mutants.name: router-claims-every-row
mutants.find: return {};   // NotLocal: an addon's row, or a container — not ours to play
mutants.replace: LeafRoute any; any.play = LeafPlay::OpenFile; return any;

mutants.//: THE HEADLINE GATE MUTANT: the tree exactly as it shipped before a92c6dd — a local route handled in the classic grid and missing from the themed one. Clause 2 must name it. No build: a source gate compiles nothing.
mutants.name: gate-themed-arm-removed
mutants.find:
case browse::LeafPlay::MusicAlbum: emit playMusicAlbumRequested(lr.key, it.url); return;
        case browse::LeafPlay::NotLocal:   break;                      // an addon's row: resolve it below
mutants.replace: case browse::LeafPlay::NotLocal:   break;                      // an addon's row: resolve it below

mutants.//: The classic grid growing a second list again: it stops consulting the table. Clause 1.
mutants.name: gate-classic-stops-consulting

mutants.//: A kind declared in LeafRoute.h and never added to the table — a whole category that answers 'Nothing to play' on BOTH surfaces. Clause 3.
mutants.name: gate-kind-declared-not-routed
mutants.replace:
inline const char* kUnroutedMime = "local:unrouted";
    // --- END LOCAL LEAF KINDS ---

mutants.//: The gate's own anti-vacuity check. Rename the function the region-splitting awk matches on and the gate must STOP rather than pass on an empty region — the failure mode where a gate reads as enforced while enforcing nothing.
mutants.name: gate-dispatch-function-moved
